description: Name: The Arab city of SakhninDescription: A city in the Sakhnin Valley in the center of the Lower Galilee - sits on an ancient Jewish settlement from the times of the Second Temple, the Mishnah and the Talmud called Sichenei, with a population of about 34,000, 96 percent Muslims and 4 percent Greek Catholic (Melchite) and Orthodox Christians. The city has 2 Orthodox churches, one Catholic church
